Who We Are
Our strategy? To be anything but typical strategy consultants! Our unconventional nature is embedded deep in our DNA. Over 60 years ago, BCG shook up the world of strategy consulting. Now, it has grown to become one of the world leaders in the field. How do we manage to stay ahead of the pack? The answer is simple: by reinventing ourselves every day and providing a home with diverse career opportunities to the best talent and most creative minds all over the world. And by giving you the chance to make an impact in business and society. BCG stands for authenticity, exceptional work, and strong integrity. Once you’ve become part of the Group, we’ll help you find your path, unleash your potential, effect change, and advance the world.
#jointhegroup
Your business is our business. If our Business Management and Operations Team had a slogan, that’s what it would be. The fact is, though, that the members of this team are far too busy ensuring our consultants’ work is efficient and productive to have the time to come up with slogans. Whether Executive or Management Assistant, Receptionist, Facility Staff member, Team Lead, or Office Manager: Each and every member of the Business Management and Operations Team contributes directly to our consultants’ success—and thus to that of our clients.
What You'll Do
As a Working Student—Reception in our Reception team, you’ll be an important point of contact for our employees and the calling card of our BCG office in Hamburg. Your daily tasks will include welcoming and supporting our clients and guests at BCG’s Hamburg office, as well as eloquently answering phone calls and forwarding them as necessary. You’ll also manage incoming and outgoing mail and organize and book courier and taxi services. In addition, you’ll manage conference rooms, which includes coordinating conference room reservations and making arrangements for catering and technical equipment. A key part of your role will be conducting regular rounds across our office spaces, proactively ensuring that all areas are well-maintained, tidy, and fully stocked with necessary supplies. You'll take a hands-on approach to keeping our office running smoothly, identifying and addressing everyday needs independently. This also includes providing practical support with setting up and rearranging meeting spaces, furniture, and technical equipment as needed. Finally, you’ll perform other special tasks that may arise.
What You'll Bring
You are a student in a bachelor’s or master’s program.
Your communication skills are demonstrated in your business-fluent German and English.
You have a good knowledge of MS Office
YOU’RE GOOD AT
As an important contact person for all BCG employees, you remain courteous and polite at all times.
Thanks to your organizational skills, you always maintain an overview, even when it gets busy.
You impress others with your structured, reliable, and independent work style.
You have a hands-on mentality, a keen eye for detail, and proactively take care of tasks wherever you see a need for action.
Strong motivation, flexibility, and commitment are as much a part of your character as absolute trustworthiness, discretion, and a sense of responsibility.
You complete administrative tasks precisely and conscientiously.
Who You'll Work With
You’ll be part of a dynamic five-person team, joining our Hamburg Reception team, whose work is characterized by helpfulness, mutual respect, trust, and of course, fun! Your regular contact with other teams will give you interesting insights into the work of different departments.
Additional info
WHAT WE OFFER YOU:
Free beverages, fresh fruit, and cereals are available every day.
Regular after-work events are organized for team-building and fun—we’d love to have you join us!
As a dynamic, internationally active company, the diverse work environment at BCG will inspire you.
WE PROUDLY OFFER:
A safe workplace with zero tolerance for harassment.
Open environments, where people are free to be themselves.
An inclusive community that believes in respect & merit
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
